text: FolderReorderListener and UserFeedbackListener dispatch data on their explicit EventTarget members. The pane installs the reorder receiver before transfer and owns insertFolder; it also owns TLS row/icon updates and matches feedback event registration with removal. The reorder receiver is once-only after an event arrives, while no arrived folder means no event. Keep the custom target requirement distinct from a generic copy-listener interface and from a durable arrived-folder result. Current server lookup/icon changes are later phases, not part of this move.
title: Folder listener modules emit data while the pane owns UI updates and event cleanup
